title: Cozy House in the Woods - 25 min from downtown
description:
Serene hilltop hideaway conveniently located within 25 minutes of downtown Nashville and all the urban happenings! Built in 2020 this 1,300 square foot home is on 1.5 acres of a beautiful deep wooded lot. Open spacious combination great room with vaulted ceilings. Covered front porch as well as a treetop deck out back for sunset and sunrise celebrations! Wonderfully private and quiet while just 15 minutes to I-40. We would love to have you come and visit!

The space
You will have the whole house to yourself. There are no shared spaces. Driveway and street parking can fit several vehicles. There are three bedrooms with a queen bed in each and two full bathrooms with tubs and showers. The open concept main room has a fully stocked kitchen, dining table with seating for 6, and a 65inch smart TV with huge comfy sectional sofa. The back deck has an awesome grill with propane and grilling utensils provided, and a table with six chairs. The front porch has two rocking chairs and a bench swing to complete the country life experience.
